scope: proposal -> trial -> probe -> measure -> promotion gates -> canary -> stable -> revalidation / cross-entry consumption

method.alternation: A B A B A B per workload
method.processes: one independent node process per measurement; 5 warm-ups then 60 measured iterations
method.secondaryMetric: process.hrtime.bigint wall clock, median per process
method.isolation: all fixtures under fresh mkdtemp; no DSH_HOME, no real experience store, no event-bridge.key read
method.concurrencyNote: other builders may run on the same machine; one B round of the refresh workload is a visible outlier (0.122 ms vs 0.067/0.071 ms), so the relative delta is not treated as a reliable gain

refresh.description: startup canary Include verification: A = verify()+health() as shipped (two refresh() calls); B = verify()+resolve-only (skip second refresh, throwaway candidate)
refresh.relativeSaving: 48.2% of this sub-operation, 0.066 ms per startup canary
refresh.decision: rejected: absolute saving too small and it removes the whole-tree consistency proof performed by health()/verify()

bridge.description: canary durable-evidence hydration: A = readEventBridgeEvidence() over a signed 2000-event log; B = no read (upper bound of any re-readelimination idea; not a correct implementation)
bridge.relativeSaving: 99.99% of this sub-operation, but B is a correctness violation
bridge.decision: rejected: the read authenticates every line and contributes the event-bridge provenance to merged durable evidence; an O(1) cache of the O(history) index is forbidden by AGENTS.md invariant 16 and redundant-work.md section 4
